title: add-external-id-to-task-model
description:
**Root Cause:** Task model has no way to reference external issue trackers (beads, Jira, etc.)
**What To Do:**
1. Add `external_id: Option<String>` to Task struct in `src/db/models.rs` (L57)
2. Add migration `ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN external_id TEXT` in `src/db/schema.rs`
3. Update `create_task` - add external_id parameter
4. Update `update_task` - include external_id
5. Update `task_from_row` - read external_id column
6. Add `external_id` to MCP `TaskSummary` in `src/mcp/server.rs` (L97)
7. Add `external_id` to MCP `TaskDetail` in `src/mcp/server.rs` (L109)
8. Update serialization in `handle_list_tasks` and `handle_get_task`
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `cargo test` passes with new field
- MCP `get_task` returns `external_id` in response
- Existing tasks get NULL external_id (no breakage)
close_reason: Added external_id: Option<String> to Task struct, DB migration, create/update/from_row, MCP TaskSummary and TaskDetail; wired into init_script shell escaping

title: add-use-worktrees-to-project-config
description:
**Root Cause:** No way to disable git worktree isolation per project. Some workflows (beads, shared-dir agents) need all agents in project root.
**What To Do:**
1. Add `use_worktrees: Option<bool>` to `ProjectConfig` in `src/config/mod.rs` (L191)
2. Update `MergedConfig::merge()` (L335): `worktree_enabled: project.use_worktrees.unwrap_or(global.worktree.enabled)`
3. This reuses existing `worktree_enabled` field in `MergedConfig` (L323) - no new field needed
4. Config format in `.agtx/config.toml`: `use_worktrees = false`
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `.agtx/config.toml` with `use_worktrees = false` sets `MergedConfig.worktree_enabled = false`
- Without setting, falls back to global `worktree.enabled` (default true)
- `cargo test` config tests pass
close_reason: Added use_worktrees: Option<bool> to ProjectConfig; MergedConfig::merge now uses project.use_worktrees.unwrap_or(global.worktree.enabled); 3 new tests cover override behavior

title: no-worktree-agent-cwd-project-root
description:
**Root Cause:** start_agent_in_tmux() uses worktree_path as CWD. Without worktree, agent must start in project root.
**What To Do:**
1. In start_agent_in_tmux(): use effective_task_path helper to resolve CWD
2. When worktree_path is None, CWD = project_path
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Agent tmux window opens in project root when use_worktrees=false
- Agent tmux window opens in worktree when use_worktrees=true (no change)

title: no-worktree-done-transition-check-project-root
description:
**Root Cause:** transition_to_done() (L3878) does worktree_path.map_or(false, ...) for uncommitted changes check. When worktree_path is None, it silently skips the check - user can lose uncommitted work.
**What To Do:**
1. In transition_to_done(): use effective_task_path to check has_changes on project root when no worktree
2. Replace: task.worktree_path.as_ref().map_or(false, |wt| git_ops.has_changes(Path::new(wt)))
3. With: git_ops.has_changes(effective_task_path(task, project_path))
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No-worktree mode: uncommitted changes in project root trigger confirmation popup
- Worktree mode: no behavior change

title: add-effective-task-path-helper
description:
**Root Cause:** Multiple callsites need to resolve task working directory (worktree or project root). Without a helper, the pattern is duplicated 10+ times and error-prone.
**What To Do:**
1. Add helper function in `src/tui/app.rs`:
   `fn effective_task_path<'a>(task: &'a Task, project_path: &'a Path) -> &'a Path`
   Returns `task.worktree_path` as Path or falls back to `project_path`
2. Use this helper in all callsites that currently do `task.worktree_path.as_ref().map_or(...)` or `unwrap_or(".")`
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Helper returns worktree_path when set
- Helper returns project_path when worktree_path is None
- No behavior change for existing worktree-based tasks
close_reason: Added effective_task_path helper; updated create_pr_with_content and push_changes_to_existing_pr to use it

title: no-worktree-artifact-detection-fallback
description:
**Root Cause:** apply_session_refresh() artifact detection (L4825-4836) returns false when worktree_path is None, meaning tasks never reach Ready state in no-worktree mode.
**What To Do:**
1. In apply_session_refresh(): use effective_task_path for artifact detection instead of worktree_path.map_or(false, ...)
2. research_artifact_exists() and phase_artifact_exists() callsites must pass effective path
3. Skip copy_back logic when worktree_path is None (files already in project root)
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Artifact files in project root trigger Ready status when use_worktrees=false
- copy_back is skipped in no-worktree mode
- Existing worktree artifact detection unchanged

title: no-worktree-skip-worktree-creation-in-planning
description:
**Root Cause:** move_to_planning() always creates git worktree and copies files. With use_worktrees=false, this must be skipped.
**What To Do:**
1. In move_to_planning(): if !worktree_enabled, skip create_worktree(), skip copy_files/copy_dirs
2. Set task.worktree_path = None
3. Still deploy skills via write_skills_to_worktree() targeting project root
4. Still run init_script with CWD = project root
5. Use effective_task_path helper for CWD resolution
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- With use_worktrees=false: no .agtx/worktrees/{slug} directory created
- Skills deployed to project root agent-native paths
- init_script runs in project root
- With use_worktrees=true: no behavior change
close_reason: Added worktree_enabled param to setup_task_worktree; skips create_worktree and initialize_worktree when false; runs plugin init_script in project root; sets worktree_path=None; all 3 callsites updated

title: create-beads-bundled-plugin
description:
**Root Cause:** No bundled plugin for beads issue tracker workflow.
**What To Do:**
1. Create plugins/beads/plugin.toml with: copy_files for .beads/issues.jsonl + metadata.json, init_script with br sync --import-only + br update {external_id}, artifacts pointing to .agtx/plan.md and .agtx/execute.md, default agtx commands/skills, done hook with br close {external_id}, copy_back for issues.jsonl
2. Add to BUNDLED_PLUGINS in src/skills.rs: ("beads", "Beads issue tracker workflow", include_str!("../plugins/beads/plugin.toml"))
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Plugin appears in plugin selector (P key)
- Plugin TOML parses without errors
- cargo build succeeds with new include_str
close_reason: Created plugins/beads/plugin.toml with init_script, copy_files, artifacts, commands, done hook, copy_back; added to BUNDLED_PLUGINS in skills.rs; updated test count

title: no-worktree-diff-and-pr-use-project-root
description:
**Root Cause:** collect_task_diff() (L5439), generate_pr_description() (L5546), and create_pr_for_task() (L5595) all use worktree_path. Without it, diff shows nothing and PR creation uses unwrap_or(".") which is fragile.
**What To Do:**
1. collect_task_diff(): accept effective path, show git diff from project root in no-worktree mode
2. generate_pr_description(): use effective path for diff_stat_from_main
3. create_pr_for_task(): replace unwrap_or(".") with explicit project_path fallback (this is also a bugfix for edge cases today)
4. handle_diff_key(): use effective_task_path, show git diff (working tree) instead of git diff main..{branch}
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Diff view (d key) works in no-worktree mode showing project root changes
- PR creation works from project root
- create_pr_for_task bugfix: no more reliance on CWD being project root

title: add-shell-escaping-for-script-placeholders
description:
**Root Cause:** Placeholders like {task} and {external_id} in init_script and done_hook are substituted directly into shell commands. Malicious or accidental special chars (;, $, backticks) cause command injection.
**What To Do:**
1. Add `shell_escape(s: &str) -> String` function in `src/skills.rs` or new helper module
2. Wrap value in single quotes, escape embedded single quotes with '\''
3. Apply shell escaping ONLY to init_script and done_hook placeholder substitution
4. Do NOT apply to commands (tmux send-keys text) or prompts (agent text) - those are not shell-executed
5. Update init_script substitution in `move_to_planning()` to use shell_escape
6. Update done_hook substitution (new, from add-done-hook bead) to use shell_escape
7. Add `{external_id}` placeholder alongside existing `{task}`, `{task_id}`, `{phase}` in both resolve_skill_command() (L5983) and resolve_prompt() (L6018) - WITHOUT escaping
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Task title containing `; rm -rf /` in init_script gets escaped to harmless string
- External_id containing `$(whoami)` in done_hook gets escaped
- Commands and prompts pass {task}/{external_id} verbatim (no escaping regression)
- Unit test covers dangerous characters
close_reason: Added shell_escape() to skills.rs; applied to init_script {task}/{task_id}/{external_id} placeholders; added {external_id} to resolve_prompt and resolve_skill_command (no escaping); 6 unit tests

title: add-done-hook-to-plugin-system
description:
**Root Cause:** Plugin system has no way to run shell commands when task transitions to Done. Needed for external tracker integration (e.g. br close).
**What To Do:**
1. Add `PluginHooks` struct to `src/config/mod.rs`: `pub struct PluginHooks { pub done: Option<String> }`
2. Add `hooks: Option<PluginHooks>` field to `WorkflowPlugin` struct (L382+)
3. Add TOML deserialization for `[hooks]` table with `done` key
4. In `src/tui/app.rs` around `cleanup_task_for_done()` (L5175): before cleanup, check plugin for done_hook
5. Run done_hook async in background thread (same pattern as `generate_pr_description` - mpsc channel, `try_recv`)
6. Substitute placeholders: `{external_id}`, `{task}`, `{task_id}`, `{phase}` with shell escaping
7. CWD: worktree_path or project root depending on mode
8. On failure: show error popup, task stays Done (best-effort)
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Plugin TOML with `[hooks] done = "echo test"` parses correctly
- Done transition triggers hook asynchronously
- Hook failure shows popup, does not block UI
- `cargo test` passes
close_reason: Added PluginHooks struct with done field; hooks field on WorkflowPlugin; spawn_done_hook helper; wired into transition_to_done and force_move_to_done; done_hook_rx polling shows warning on failure

title: no-worktree-skip-merge-conflict-check
description:
**Root Cause:** Merge conflict auto-detection checks worktree branch vs default branch. In no-worktree mode there is no per-task branch.
**What To Do:**
1. In apply_session_refresh() merge conflict check: skip when task.worktree_path is None and task.branch_name is None
2. Guard: if no branch_name, do not attempt git merge-tree check
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No-worktree mode: no merge conflict check attempted, no errors
- Worktree mode: merge conflict detection unchanged

title: no-worktree-cleanup-skip-worktree-removal
description:
**Root Cause:** cleanup_task_for_done() (L5175) archives .agtx/ from worktree and removes worktree. In no-worktree mode, there is nothing to remove and artifacts are shared.
**What To Do:**
1. In cleanup_task_for_done(): if worktree_path is None, skip archive and skip remove_worktree()
2. Still cleanup tmux window (that part stays)
3. No artifact archiving in no-worktree mode (artifacts are shared in project root)
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No-worktree: tmux window closed, no filesystem cleanup attempted
- Worktree mode: archive + remove worktree (no change)

title: wizard-external-id-input
description:
**Root Cause:** Task creation wizard has no way to set external_id. Without it, beads plugin done_hook cannot close the external issue.
**What To Do:**
1. Add wizard state field: wizard_external_id: String in AppState
2. In Title step (InputMode::InputTitle): add secondary input "External ID (optional):" below title
3. Tab switches focus between title and external_id within Title step
4. Breadcrumbs stay 3-step (Title/Plugin/Prompt) - external_id is part of Title step
5. In save_task() (L3368): set task.external_id from wizard_external_id (None if empty)
6. In init_description_input() (L3456) for editing: restore external_id from task to wizard state
7. Clear wizard_external_id on cancel_wizard()
**Acceptance Criteria:**
- New task wizard shows optional External ID field in Title step
- Tab toggles between title and external_id inputs
- Saved task has external_id in DB
- Edit task restores external_id
- Empty external_id saves as None
